THE UNOTIFY TRAP FLOW

The guest kernel's seccomp filter defers every intercepted syscall to
the shim through the unotify fd; each entry below names one stage of
the flow in firing order — a pointer at an entry means the entry, the
whole line (the diagram convention).

Kernel seccomp-unotify triggers
Shim polls the notify fd and reads the request
Shim emulates, forwards, or denies the syscall
Shim writes the response and wakes the guest waiter
